title: Remove frame_tvbuff.[ch]
description:
Remove unnecessary and experimental code for "frame_tvbuff",
simplify epan API usage and improve performance.

notes.body: Can anyone tell me if this still serves any purpose? Why a "frame_tvbuff"?

It looks like the initial idea was f3ed13c22e:

> tvbuff: replace type with operation vtable
>
> It's begin of work to allow adding new tvbuff types (think: wtap_tvbuff, base64_tvbuff).

However, those were never added or proposed as far as I can tell.
